prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: shoulder injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1351; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully traveling in the right lane when your insured, while changing lanes without signaling or checking the blind spot, sideswiped our client's vehicle. The force of the impact spun our client's car and pushed it toward the shoulder, leaving no reasonable opportunity to avoid the collision. Responsibility for this accident rests squarely with your insured, whose negligence violated basic duties of safe lane change under state traffic law.

As a result of the collision, our client suffered a significant shoulder injury that required prompt medical evaluation, imaging, and a course of physical therapy. Our client continues to experience pain, reduced range of motion, and limitations on daily activities, including lifting and driving for extended periods. Medical records and billing documentation are available and will be provided upon request.

Based on the medical expenses incurred, lost wages, pain and suffering, and the ongoing impact on our client's quality of life, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve this claim. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice.
